long_biography.plain_text:
Tony DeFelice entered construction from an unusually strong starting platform: his father and uncle had built one of Victoria's largest home builders and assembled a substantial Bayswater property portfolio. He still began on building sites as a labourer, after studying architectural drafting, before developing multimillion-dollar homes independently.

When his father stepped back, DeFelice returned to the family enterprise and redirected it from home building toward property development and management. His current work includes residential land subdivisions and commercial factory projects through multiple companies. Those project and portfolio assets belong to their respective entities; their aggregate values are not a measure of his personal wealth.
